meta.title: Twenty Bats
meta.textType: counting: numbers to twenty and plurals

paragraphs: Lily and Sam sit next to the water. It is evening. "Let's count the animals," says Sam. "I see four frogs," says Lily. The frogs are green. Sam sees a snake. It has a long gray tail. "It is scary!" says Lily. "No, it is small," says Sam. Pip sits behind Lily.

Lily sees a spider. The spider is on a tree. "Count the legs," says Sam. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight! "The spider has eight legs," says Lily. "Look at the water," says Sam. Two frogs jump in the water. Two frogs sit on the grass. "Four frogs, one snake, one spider," says Lily.

Then Sam says, "Look at the trees!" The bats come. "How many bats can you see?" asks Sam. They count the bats. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen! Sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty! "Twenty bats!" says Lily. "They are beautiful," says Lily. Pip looks at the bats.
text.summary: Lily and Sam count animals next to the water in the evening. They see frogs, a snake, a spider, and twenty bats.
